doc.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: Well, we know you’re going to join you, you’re going to go teach your class, this is an ensemble class with James Newton, we’re looking forward to joining you there. But I guess we’ll go ahead and wrap this up as the formal interview portion…
Okay. Brown:…of our trying to have your life in music, your thoughts, your philosophies and your passion…
Thank you. Brown:…for the historical record.

And Kenny Burrell, we thank you, and please just keep keeping on, keep doing what you’re doing because as your mother said, “Do good work and good will come back to you.” I think you’re a living proof of that…
And we thank you so much.
